newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soy up, wheat steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soy up, wheat steady.

text.p: FOB Gulf basis values for corn and soybeans rose on Thursday while wheat values were mostly steady.

"CBOT corn and soybean futures recovered and soybean values are readjusting," one dealer said. The dealer was referring to the strong soybean close on Thursday. Also, there were some overnight export sales.
State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp bought 20,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow corn and 10,000 tonnes of No.2 or better U.S. yellow soybeans from Cargill at a tender on Thursday, traders said.
Also, Jordan is seeking to buy 50,000 tonnes of U.S. Number 3 yellow corn in one lot for shipment in the first half of November, traders said.

Tunisia bought 125,000 optional origina soft wheat. Philippine flour mills bought 18,900 tonnes of U.S. white wheat and South Korea's Dae Han Flour Mills Co Ltd said on Thursday it has bought 23,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat from Japan's Mitsui and Company. Shipment was set for January 5-February 5 to the western port of Inchon.
Dealers quoted the following afternoon FOB U.S. Gulf values, basis Chicago futures, except hard red winter wheat basis Kansas City. (In cents per bushel).
